title: 第1744章 紫霄雷域第1743章 毫无意义的羁绊
slug: 瞎婿第1754章总算找到你了
content_zh:
“少……少会长……您怎么在这里？”那魁梧大汉看到楚天铭的瞬间，顿时惊慌失措道。
楚天铭却没有理会他，而是径直走到了张小驴的身边，淡淡道：“还能起来吗？”
“我能……”
张小驴咬着后槽牙，从地上缓慢的爬了起来，断骨的剧痛，让他的额头上，青筋暴起，身体更是抖动不止。
“还好，没死就行。”
楚天铭手掌一翻，两粒丹药出现在了他的掌心当中。
“吃上一粒，你的伤势就会好转，剩下的那粒，给你爷爷吃。”
“好。”
张小驴按照楚天铭的话，迅速吃下了一粒疗伤丹，很快他就感觉到一股温热的力量，游走全身，而断裂的骨头，在这股力量之下，却是开始迅速修复。
不到片刻的功夫，张小驴就恢复如初了。
张小驴一个箭步冲到了气息奄奄的张云海面前，然后将丹药塞入了他的口中。
“这家伙难道真的跟少会长有关系？那老子岂不是……”魁梧大汉眼珠子一转，立刻向着后方大门退去。
“哪里跑！”
楚天铭立刻抬手，上万柄古剑同时呼啸而出，化作漫天剑雨，向着魁梧大汉轰去。
“不好！”
魁梧大汉连忙挥舞着链锤，试图挡下那袭来的剑雨，可是楚天铭的实力，如何是张小驴可比。
那些青铜古剑，每一柄古剑之上，都蕴含着极为强大的能量。
而这上万柄古剑同时落下，其能量有多么恐怖，就可想而知了。
锵锵锵！
那链锤虽然勉强抵挡下了几柄古剑，但是更多的古剑袭来，魁梧男子根本无法抵挡，只能连连后退。

“少会长，这一切都是误会……”
“误会？”
楚天铭冷哼一声，右手掐动法印：“你真以为刚才我什么都没有听到吗？”
下一秒！
上万柄古剑疯狂斩下，铁链被斩断，链锤被击碎，魁梧男子男子的身躯，也是被击穿了一个个血洞。
“怎么会这样……”那魁梧男子仰面倒地，一命呜呼。
“这就是真正的云霄剑诀吗？好强……”望着刚才那令人震惊的画面，张小驴的脸上露出了向往神色。
“小驴……”
这个时候，张云海也苏醒了过来，立刻大叫道。
“爷爷，我在这里，我在这里！”张小驴急忙将张云海扶起。
“你……你没事？”张云海有些激动的摸了摸张小驴温热的脸颊：“我不是在做梦吧？”
“爷爷，你当然没有做梦，是楚大哥救的我。”张小驴急忙道。
“恩公？”
张云海抬头看去，这才发现站在旁边的楚天铭。
content_en:
"Young... Young President... Why are you here?" The burly man suddenly panicked when he saw Chu Tianming.
Chu Tianming ignored him, but walked straight to Zhang Xiaolu and said calmly: "Can you still get up?"
"I can..."
Zhang Xiaolu gritted his back molars and slowly climbed up from the ground. The severe pain from the broken bone caused veins to pop out on his forehead and his body was shaking even more.
"It's okay, as long as he's not dead."
Chu Tianming turned his palm, and two pills appeared in his palm.
"Take one pill and your injury will get better. Give the remaining pill to your grandpa."
"Okay."
Zhang Xiaolu followed Chu Tianming's words and quickly took a healing pill. Soon he felt a warm force flowing through his body, and the broken bones began to repair quickly under this force.
In less than a moment, Zhang Xiaolu was back to his original state.
Zhang Xiaolu rushed to the dying Zhang Yunhai in one stride, and then stuffed the elixir into his mouth.
"Is this guy really related to the young president? Then I am..." The burly man rolled his eyes and immediately retreated towards the rear door.
"Where to run!"
Chu Tianming immediately raised his hand, and tens of thousands of ancient swords roared out at the same time, turning into a rain of swords from the sky, and blasted towards the burly man.
"Not good!"
The burly man hurriedly waved his chain hammer, trying to block the oncoming sword rain, but Chu Tianming's strength was comparable to Zhang Xiaolu's.
Each of those ancient bronze swords contains extremely powerful energy.
And if these tens of thousands of ancient swords fall down at the same time, you can imagine how terrifying their energy is.
Clang, clang, clang!
Although the chain hammer barely resisted a few ancient swords, more ancient swords came and the burly man was unable to resist them and could only retreat continuously.
"Young President, this is all a misunderstanding..."
"Misunderstanding?"
Chu Tianming snorted coldly and pinched the seal with his right hand: "Do you really think I didn't hear anything just now?"
The next second!
Tens of thousands of ancient swords were chopped down crazily, the iron chains were cut off, the hammers were shattered, and the burly man's body was also penetrated with bloody holes.
"How could this happen..." The burly man fell to the ground on his back, dying.
"Is this the real Yunxiao Sword Art? It's so powerful..." Looking at the shocking scene just now, Zhang Xiaolu's face showed a look of yearning.
"Little donkey..."
At this time, Zhang Yunhai also woke up and immediately shouted.
"Grandpa, I'm here, I'm here!" Zhang Xiaolu hurriedly helped Zhang Yunhai up.
"You...are you okay?" Zhang Yunhai touched Zhang Xiaolu's warm cheek with some excitement: "I'm not dreaming, am I?"
"Grandpa, of course you weren't dreaming. It was Brother Chu who saved me." Zhang Xiaolu said hurriedly.
"Benefactor?"
Zhang Yunhai looked up and found Chu Tianming standing next to him.
